content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for District Hospital Mancherial Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for District Hospital Mancherial?
faq.answer: The last date to attend the walk-in interview for the Civil Assistant Surgeon Specialist posts at District Hospital Mancherial is 30th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Civil Assistant Surgeon Specialist post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Civil Assistant Surgeon Specialist post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 1,00,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q3. What are the essential qualifications required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree with a Degree or Diploma in the relevant specialty and be registered with the Medical Council of India.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Civil Assistant Surgeon Specialist position?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for the Civil Assistant Surgeon Specialist posts at District Hospital Mancherial.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview in person with all required documents.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Civil Assistant Surgeon Specialist posts?
faq.answer: The selection process is based on 90% marks in the relevant course and 10% marks based on the year of passing the relevant course.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the Superintendent, District Hospitals Head Office (TVVP), IDOC, F24, Naspur.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry original certificates and Xerox copies of all relevant documents, including educational qualifications, registration, and identity proof.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The job type for these positions is Contractual.
